notes: Two releases in one update. THE RECONCILIATION SCREEN OPENS STRAIGHT AWAY - it stalled for about half a minute on every machine; that is now under one second, with no figure changed. THE EXCEPTIONS PANEL STOPS CRYING WOLF over an opening cheque written back when it went stale. THE HORIZON NOTE counts only what would actually have appeared behind it, not every entry on the account. A MONTH SIGNED OVER A KNOWN DISAGREEMENT now asks, and the filed version records what stood. A STATEMENT RUNNING PAST THE MONTH END no longer offers next month's lines for matching. PAYROLL APPROVAL can no longer be granted by editing the record, and A FILED SIGN-OFF is stamped by the server, not the app. Installing: no data changes and no ledger entries. Installs over the previous version - please still take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now. Full notes are on the download page.
